group_size.fil: Pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

purpose.en: Make team roles and communication visible.
purpose.fil: Makita ang tungkulin at komunikasyon ng pangkat.

materials.en: Tape or a drawn tabletop space and counters
materials.fil: Tape o espasyong iginuhit sa mesa at mga pananda

steps.en: Agree a shared goal and roles before starting.
steps.fil: Pagkasunduan ang layunin at tungkulin bago magsimula.

steps.en: Gradually shrink a marked space. The team agrees how everyone stays included. No lifting, pushing or forced physical contact.
steps.fil: Unti-unting paliitin ang espasyo. Pagkasunduan kung paano maisasama ang lahat. Walang pagbubuhat, pagtulak o sapilitang pagdikit.

steps.en: Ask each learner what they contributed and what they would change.
steps.fil: Itanong sa bawat isa ang naiambag at nais baguhin.

debrief.en: Was the goal clear? How did you respond to disagreement?
debrief.fil: Malinaw ba ang layunin? Paano tinugunan ang di-pagkakasundo?

observe.en: Participation is not a competency rating; use the individual teamwork role-play next.
observe.fil: Hindi rating ng kakayahan ang pagsali; gamitin ang indibidwal na role-play pagkatapos.

output.en: One teamwork lesson from each participant.
output.fil: Isang natutuhan sa teamwork bawat kalahok.

alternative.en: Use seated counters or a paper planning challenge for accessibility or limited supplies.
alternative.fil: Gumamit ng pananda sa mesa o pagpaplano sa papel para sa accessibility o limitadong kagamitan.

group_size.fil: Pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

purpose.en: Make team roles and communication visible.
purpose.fil: Makita ang tungkulin at komunikasyon ng pangkat.

materials.en: Per group: 20 spaghetti sticks, tape, one metre of string, one marshmallow
materials.fil: Bawat pangkat: 20 spaghetti sticks, tape, isang metrong tali, isang marshmallow

steps.en: Agree a shared goal and roles before starting.
steps.fil: Pagkasunduan ang layunin at tungkulin bago magsimula.

steps.en: Allow 10 minutes to build a freestanding tower with the marshmallow on top.
steps.fil: Maglaan ng 10 minuto para bumuo ng nakatayong tore na may marshmallow sa itaas.

steps.en: Ask each learner what they contributed and what they would change.
steps.fil: Itanong sa bawat isa ang naiambag at nais baguhin.

debrief.en: Was the goal clear? How did you respond to disagreement?
debrief.fil: Malinaw ba ang layunin? Paano tinugunan ang di-pagkakasundo?

observe.en: Participation is not a competency rating; use the individual teamwork role-play next.
observe.fil: Hindi rating ng kakayahan ang pagsali; gamitin ang indibidwal na role-play pagkatapos.

output.en: One teamwork lesson from each participant.
output.fil: Isang natutuhan sa teamwork bawat kalahok.

alternative.en: Use seated counters or a paper planning challenge for accessibility or limited supplies.
alternative.fil: Gumamit ng pananda sa mesa o pagpaplano sa papel para sa accessibility o limitadong kagamitan.

group_size.fil: Pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

purpose.en: Show clear purpose, roles and openness to issues and feedback.
purpose.fil: Ipakita ang malinaw na layunin, tungkulin at pagiging bukas sa isyu at puna.

steps.en: Card: one assigned purok has not been visited for two weeks; teammates complain among themselves.
steps.fil: Card: dalawang linggong hindi nadalaw ang nakatalagang purok; nagrereklamuhan ang mga kasamahan.

steps.en: Assign BHW, teammate and observer. Hold a three-minute conversation; ask about barriers before agreeing a next step.
steps.fil: Italaga ang BHW, kasama at tagamasid. Mag-usap nang tatlong minuto; alamin ang hadlang bago magkasundo sa hakbang.

steps.en: Rotate, give specific feedback and repeat the difficult part.
steps.fil: Magpalit, magbigay ng tiyak na puna at ulitin ang mahirap na bahagi.

debrief.fil: Ano ang kailangang pagkasunduan sa midwife?

observe.en: Look for at least three module teamwork recommendations: purpose, roles, openness to issues, feedback and respectful relationships. Observe each BHW separately.
observe.fil: Hanapin ang hindi bababa sa tatlong rekomendasyon: layunin, tungkulin, pagiging bukas sa isyu, puna at magalang na ugnayan. Obserbahan ang bawat BHW.

output.fil: Indibidwal na obserbasyon at isang dapat pagbutihin.

alternative.en: Use a paired conversation observed by the trainer.
alternative.fil: Magkaparehang usapan na inoobserbahan ng trainer.

worksheet.en: Purpose / roles / issue raised / response to feedback / next step
worksheet.fil: Layunin / tungkulin / isyung inilahad / tugon sa puna / hakbang

group_size.fil: Pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

purpose.en: Explain who handles a concern using a verified local chart.
purpose.fil: Ipaliwanag kung sino ang hahawak ng concern gamit ang natiyak na lokal na chart.

materials.en: Coordinator-verified local chart and organizational policies
materials.fil: Lokal na chart at polisiyang tiniyak ng coordinator

steps.en: Trainer presents the chart and models a communication route.
steps.fil: Ipakita ng trainer ang chart at daloy ng komunikasyon.

steps.en: Give cards: service concern, resource request, reporting question. Identify the first contact and explain why.
steps.fil: Magbigay ng card: concern sa serbisyo, hiling na kagamitan, tanong sa report. Tukuyin ang unang lalapitan at dahilan.

steps.en: Each learner explains four partner roles; mark unknown local details for verification.
steps.fil: Ipaliwanag ng bawat isa ang apat na tungkulin ng katuwang; markahan ang dapat tiyakin.

debrief.en: When should a concern move to another partner?
debrief.fil: Kailan ililipat ang concern sa ibang katuwang?

observe.en: Selects the appropriate contact and describes partner roles accurately.
observe.fil: Tama ang pinipiling katuwang at paliwanag ng tungkulin.

output.fil: Chart na may tala at indibidwal na paliwanag.

alternative.en: Use role titles and mark unverified local details if a chart is unavailable.
alternative.fil: Gamitin ang titulo at markahan ang di-tiyak na lokal na detalye kung walang chart.

worksheet.en: Concern / first contact / reason / next contact

group_size.fil: Pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

purpose.en: Practise meeting roles, turn-taking and clear decisions.
purpose.fil: Magsanay sa tungkulin sa pulong, pakikinig at malinaw na pasya.

steps.en: Trainer models purpose, agenda, roles and speaking order using local meeting protocols.
steps.fil: Ipakita ng trainer ang layunin, agenda, tungkulin at pagkakasunod ng pagsasalita gamit ang lokal na protocol.

steps.en: Assign chair, recorder and members. Plan a fictional information session with disagreement over timing.
steps.fil: Italaga ang tagapangulo, tagatala at miyembro. Planuhin ang kathang information session na may di-pagkakasundo sa oras.

steps.en: Agree action, owner and date. Read the decision back. Rotate roles and repeat.
steps.fil: Pagkasunduan ang aksiyon, responsable at petsa. Basahin muli ang pasya. Magpalit at ulitin.

debrief.en: Was each voice heard? Can someone act on the decision?
debrief.fil: Napakinggan ba ang lahat? Malinaw ba ang gagawing aksiyon?

observe.en: Shows clear purpose and roles, raises issues and responds to feedback.
observe.fil: Malinaw ang layunin at tungkulin, naihahayag ang isyu at natutugunan ang puna.

output.en: Fictional meeting minutes and observed teamwork.

worksheet.en: Agenda / issue / agreed action / owner / date / confirmation
worksheet.fil: Agenda / isyu / aksiyon / responsable / petsa / kumpirmasyon

group_size.fil: Pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

purpose.fil: Planuhin ang prayoridad at hangganan ng gawain.

steps.en: Recall competing tasks or use three fictional tasks due the same day.
steps.fil: Ipaalala ang sabay-sabay na gawain o gumamit ng tatlong kathang gawaing sabay ang takdang araw.

steps.en: Write a weekly plan and one SMART goal. Include confirmation of assignments with the supervisor.
steps.fil: Gumawa ng lingguhang plano at isang SMART goal. Isama ang pagkumpirma ng assignment sa supervisor.

steps.en: A partner checks feasibility. Practise asking for help if the workload cannot fit.
steps.fil: Ipasuri sa kapareha kung kaya. Magsanay humingi ng tulong kung sobra ang gawain.

debrief.en: What can you change and what needs agreement?
debrief.fil: Ano ang mababago mo at ano ang kailangang pagkasunduan?

observe.en: Writes a specific goal and realistic weekly plan; names a strength and a skill needing practice.
observe.fil: May tiyak na layunin at kayang plano; nasasabi ang kalakasan at dapat sanayin.

output.fil: Lingguhang plano at petsa ng review.

alternative.en: Offer quiet writing instead of personal sharing.
alternative.fil: Tahimik na pagsulat bilang alternatibo sa personal na pagbabahagi.

worksheet.en: Task / priority / time / support / SMART goal / review date
worksheet.fil: Gawain / prayoridad / oras / suporta / SMART goal / petsa ng review
